reviews.review: Great game. Does a good job of staying true to the alien universe in terms of xenos, weapons, class types, etc. Even the standard pulse rifle has the OG sound effect from the 2nd aliens movie. Had this on ps5 first, but went back to pc gaming. So I decided to pick this up again and run through it all one more time.

Amazing game. If it wasn't Alien themed, I wouldn't have tried it, but I'm so glad I did. 

The Good:
Each soldier class feels different and has multiple 'build' options thanks to the various perks. The perk grid is the coolest one in recent memory. You can focus on 1 ability or spread modifiers around & even borrow some skills from other classes.
Tons of progression in the form of new perks, weapons, weapon attachments, and mission modifiers (challenge cards). The hardest difficulty is brutal, but doable with good planning and the right build.
Music is literally award winning. Sound effects are great and authentic to the franchise.
For the Alien franchise fans, this feels really loyal to the source material. There are collectibles in each level that unlock more lore & dialogue from the crew.
Plenty of costume/skin options to feel as cool (or silly) as you like.

The Middleground:
The graphics are fine. Nothing life changing. Nothing looks 'bad' and there are plenty of UI options to help convey what's happening (things like hit markers and interaction prompts).
AI buddies will do their job, but become frustrating on harder difficulties. They only use basic equipment, and have a habit of blocking your 'lane' when trying to fight in close quarters. To the game's credit, they warn you to not rely on AI when going above 'medium' difficulty.

The Bad:
Campaign just isn't quite long enough. Other game modes help stretch out the content, but I really would have loved a longer campaign. Replayability is ok with higher difficulties and mission modifiers, but I really wish we could have gotten more story.
No tutorial to speak of. You can mess around in the hub area to learn the controls and see what weapons/abilities do, but it would be nice to have a quick 'boot camp' or something to learn mechanics.

All in all, definitely pick this one up if you want a fun horde shooter. Support/updates are pretty few & far between these days, so maybe wait for a sale.

Massive improvement on previous Alien games. Nothing beats the sound of the assault rifle.
Challenge cards were a good addition to add some replay value to it.

i enjoyed it a lot i played for about 10 hours too complete the entire campaign and didnt feel like playing any more than that. its like left for dead but aliens. i would mostly recommend it with friends or using the ingame matchmaking. way more fun that way.

Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a fun 3rd person shooter. You and 2 others (why 3? no clue, every other team game has always been 4) form a fireteam. Unfortunately it is designed to be multiplayer, so there is NO such thing as pausing the game. 
If you don't want people, you can have 2 synthetics (Alpha and Beta) that are decent enough on standard difficulty, but the higher difficulties all warn against using them. They also don't have a class so really they are just generic fire support.

As for you, you get to pick one of 6 classes which each have access to 2 weapon types. Rifle, CQW (Shotgun, SMG), Heavy, and/or Pistol.
Each class also has 2 special abilities.

You can add attachments, colors, and decals to your weapons. As you level up, you get perks and perk modifiers to further customize your classes. Bonus: Many/most? of the perks and modifiers can be used by all the classes, so if you are mostly playing Lancer, but want to try out Doc, you can get some bonuses.

Gives off an Army of Two (Three?) vibe. 

Missions are 20-45 minutes depending on skill and how much looking around you do. There is a Hidden Cache (that respawns in a random spot each time you play) and 3 collectibles (one time pickup) for each mission.
